data.body: Closed (preexisting). Landed via Gerrit change 1897 patchset 3 -> merged as d7d7594305 on origin/main (LLM-Review +1 AND Verified +1, submitted). Fix: _cli.main now serves --help/-h in any position before a -- terminator for leaf commands (fixing the create task --help placeholder write), with a family-aware _help_requested wrapper that preserves the bridge group's nested help (bridge --help == help bridge; bridge preview --help -> preview usage). Regression + unit tests added. Two CI-caught regressions (bridge nested help + sub-help/help-sub parity) were fixed before landing.
